aciklama: Bölüm 9 görsellerinin üretim istemleri ve kaydı (docs/GORSEL_USLUP.md → Tutarlılık). Her üretimde `uretimler` listesine araç, model, tarih ve seçilen dosya eklenir. İstemler İngilizce; modeller İngilizceyi daha iyi izliyor.

uslup.istem: Flat-shape illustration for a documentary motion comic in a paper cut-out style: layered flat shapes with clear depth planes, each plane like a sheet of textured paper with a soft shadow beneath it. Muted, low-saturation earth palette: sand, ochre, raw umber, warm grey stone; deep indigo for night, soft apricot for dawn and dusk. Gentle atmospheric haze, clean readable silhouettes, calm and respectful mood. Setting: Mecca, Hijaz, around 605 CE — a narrow valley among bare, rocky, almost treeless mountains; small flat-roofed houses of mudbrick and rough stone. Cinematic 16:9 framing.

referans.not: u01-d, Erdem seçti (2026-11-13). Her üretime image_references olarak verilir; yalnız üslup ve palet için, kompozisyon için değil.

uslup.yasaklar: No minarets, no domes, no crescents, no arches, no tiles, no Ottoman or modern architecture, no modern Masjid al-Haram. No text, letters, logos or watermarks. No visible faces: people appear only as distant silhouettes, from behind, or as hands and fabric details. Never depict the Prophet in any form — no figure, silhouette, shadow, hand or foot; his presence is only a soft warm golden-white light. No angels. No blood.
uslup.katman_kurali: Katmanlar ayrı üretilir. Gök katmanı hariç her katman düz, tek renk #00B140 (yeşil perde) zemin üzerinde istenir; zemin sonra `tools/gorsel_katman.py` ile silinip şeffaf WebP yapılır. Konu yeşil içeriyorsa (ör. s06'daki yeşil temel taşları) zemin mavi perde #0047BB istenir ve betik `--mavi` ile çalıştırılır; gök `--opak` ile. Görsel 16:9 kadrajdan her yöne %10 taşacak genişlikte düşünülür; ana öğe alt %25'e (altyazı alanı) düşmez.
uslup.yesil_perde_eki: Isolated on a perfectly flat, uniform pure chroma-green background (#00B140), no shadows on the background, no green tint on the subject.
bilincli_olarak_cizilmeyenler: Kâbe örtüsü (kisve): 605'teki durumu kaynakla netleşmedi. Yapım sahnelerinde örtüsüz; s01'de Kâbe yalnız uzak planda.
Kâbe çevresindeki putlar: görünüşleri kaynakla netleşene kadar çizilmez.
Benî Şeybe kapısının biçimi ve Hicr'in sınırı: kaynakta yok.

deneme_plani.aciklama: Higgsfield 3 günlük deneme: ~100 kredi ≈ 50 Nano Banana Pro görseli (2K). Sıra önemli: önce üslup, sonra mekân kartları, sonra zor sahneler.

turlar.not: u01 dört varyantla iki kez; Erdem birini seçer, seçilen görsel sonraki her üretime referans olarak verilir.

turlar.hedef: Temsil kuralını en çok zorlayan sahneler: s07, s11, s12, s13
Eksik katmanlar ve s14 oranı (a seçeneği)
turlar.not: ChatGPT Go. Toz ve nur oynatıcı efekti olarak kalır.

istemler.amac: Üslup denemesi: tek parça anahtar kare (katmansız). Dört varyant: (a) bu istem, (b) 'gouache', (c) 'ink and watercolor', (d) 'flat shapes, paper cut-out depth'.
istemler.istem: Wide establishing shot at dawn: the Mecca valley seen from a slight height, bare rocky mountains in layered haze, scattered low flat-roofed mudbrick houses, and in the open center a small, low, plain cube-shaped structure of dry-stacked dark stones without mortar, barely taller than a person, no roof covering. Tiny distant silhouettes, no faces.
Sky only, dawn: deep indigo at the top fading to soft apricot near the horizon, a few thin high clouds, no land.
Two overlapping ranges of bare, jagged, rocky desert mountains seen from the valley floor, the far range paler with haze, no vegetation, no buildings. {yesil_perde_eki}
istemler.not: Gök yerine yeşil perde; dağların üst kenarı temiz kesilsin.

istemler.istem: Valley floor only: packed sand and gravel ground receding toward the horizon, scattered small stones, a dry stream bed trace. {yesil_perde_eki}
A loose row of small flat-roofed houses of mudbrick and rough stone along the valley, simple wooden doors, a few low walls; an empty open space in the center of the row. No people. {yesil_perde_eki}
istemler.not: Ortadaki boşluk Kâbe ve avlu için.

istemler.istem: A small, low, plain cube-shaped building of dry-stacked dark grey stones without mortar, walls only slightly taller than a person, no roof, no covering cloth, no decoration, seen from a three-quarter angle. Strictly a cube: straight vertical walls and sharp square corners, not round. Soot stains and flood marks at the base. {yesil_perde_eki}
istemler.kaynak: İbn Hişâm s. 122 (harçsız, insan boyunun üstünde, çatısız); TDV KUREYŞ s. 443 (yangın ve sel).

istemler.istem: The same cube-shaped stone building under reconstruction: walls rising unevenly, courses of dark stone alternating with thin wooden beams, an empty notch at one corner at chest height, piles of stones and timber at the base. No people. {yesil_perde_eki}
istemler.kaynak: TDV KÂBE s. 16 (bir sıra taş, bir sıra ahşap hatıl). Köşedeki boşluk Hacerülesved'in yeri.

istemler.istem: The finished cube-shaped stone building, now about twice as tall as before, with a flat roof, courses of dark stone and thin wooden beams, a single-leaf wooden door set high above the ground, no covering cloth, no decoration. Beside it, an open semicircular area left outside the building, its edge only faintly suggested. No stairs or steps of any kind; the door simply sits high in the bare wall. {yesil_perde_eki}
istemler.kaynak: İbn Hişâm s. 126 (18 arşın); TDV KÂBE s. 16-17 (yüksek, tek kanatlı kapı); Buhârî, Hac, 42 (Hicr dışarıda).

istemler.istem: Seen from behind at close range: a man in a simple undyed wool robe and head cloth walking up a stony slope, carrying a rough stone on his right shoulder; his face is not visible at all. {yesil_perde_eki}
istemler.not: Abbas. Yüz kesinlikle görünmez. Sahne onun gözünden: kadrajda bakan kişinin hiçbir uzvu yok.

istemler.istem: Eye-level view up a gentle stony path toward a construction site in the distance, loose stones and dust on the ground; no hands, arms, feet or body of the viewer in frame. Only the path, ground and loose stones: no buildings, no walls, no scaffolding. {yesil_perde_eki}

First-person view from a simple narrow gap between two mudbrick house walls, looking out into a sunlit open courtyard; the walls frame the left and right edges in shadow. No arch, no monumental gate. No hands, arms, feet or body of the viewer. The courtyard is empty in the center: no building, no cube-shaped structure, no people. {yesil_perde_eki}
istemler.not: Kapının o dönemki biçimi kaynakta yok; sade aralık. Üretilen görsel avluyu da içerdi; yalnız iki yandaki duvarlar elle maskelenip çerçeve katmanı yapıldı.

maske.aciklama: gorsel-ham/b09/s11-giris.png önce varsayılan ayarla (kırparak) gorsel_katman.py ile çevrilir; sonra yalnız bu iki çokgenin içi bırakılır (alfa = min(perde alfası, çokgen)), kenar 1.5 px Gauss ile yumuşatılır. Koordinatlar ham 1536×1024 görselde; katmana dönüşüm x·1.5, y·1.5−120.

istemler.istem: A crowd of men in simple robes and head cloths standing in a courtyard at middle distance, many turning toward the viewer, faces not visible — in shadow, turned away or too far to see any features. Only the people: no building, no cube-shaped structure, no houses behind them. {yesil_perde_eki}

Top-down view of a plain undyed cloth spread on a stone floor, a smooth black stone resting at its center; four men's hands and forearms reach in from the four edges of the frame, each gripping one corner of the cloth. A soft warm golden-white glow rests over the stone, as if from an unseen light. Only these four pairs of hands; no other hand, arm or body anywhere.
istemler.not: Resûlullah'a ait el ya da kol çizilmez; yalnız nur. Yapay zekâ beşinci bir el eklemeye meyilli; elle kontrol.

istemler.istem: Close-up of a wall of dry-stacked dark stones with thin wooden beams; at the corner a smooth black stone set into a niche at chest height. A soft warm golden-white glow fades around the stone. No hands, no people.
istemler.not: Gerçek görsel gelince yer tutucu 'nur' katmanı kaldırılabilir ya da hafif bırakılır.

istemler.istem: Sky only, clear midday: pale dusty blue, slightly lighter and warmer near the horizon, a few faint thin clouds, no land.
Sky only, dusk just after sunset: muted violet-grey at the top fading to dull apricot and rose near the horizon, a few thin dark clouds, no land.
Sky only, night: deep indigo, many small faint stars, a soft lighter haze near the horizon, no moon, no land.
istemler.not: Ay yok: s09 tarifindeki ayın evresi kaynakta yok; gerekirse oynatıcı çizer.

istemler.istem: The finished cube-shaped stone building, clearly about twice as tall as its earlier low version: its walls are TALLER THAN THEY ARE WIDE. Flat roof, courses of dark stone alternating with thin wooden beams, a single-leaf wooden door set high in the wall with no stairs or steps, no covering cloth, no decoration. Straight vertical walls, sharp square corners. Only a thin strip of ground under it. {yesil_perde_eki}
istemler.not: m07 basık çıktı (yükseklik alçak hâlin 1,47 katı); Erdem (a) seçeneğini seçti (2026-11-13).

istemler.istem: Seen from far away across an open space: a long, low, loose row of small flat-roofed houses of mudbrick and rough stone, single storey, small in the frame, along the foot of the valley; a wide empty gap in the middle of the row. Houses occupy only the middle third of the image height. No people. {yesil_perde_eki}
istemler.not: Eski evler katmanı ön plan ölçeğindeydi; Kâbe her sahnede küçük görünüyordu.

istemler.istem: Close-up of an old wall of rough, dry-stacked dark stones without mortar: soot stains blackening the stones, worn and cracked surfaces, dry earth washed into the gaps between stones, and a dried flood line with a crust of silt along the base of the wall. No people, no hands.
istemler.not: Kaynak: TDV KUREYŞ s. 443 (yangın ve sel).

istemler.istem: Red Sea coast at noon: a calm sea stretching to a flat horizon, a wide sandy beach in the foreground, small low waves at the shoreline, no boats, no ships, no buildings. {yesil_perde_eki}
istemler.not: Gök ayrı katman; ufkun üstü yeşil perde.

istemler.istem: A broken wooden ship hull lying on its side on sand, split open, with loose planks scattered around it. Keep the ship generic and simple: no sails, no rigging, no flags, no carvings, no identifiable ship type. {yesil_perde_eki}
istemler.not: Gemi tipi kaynakla netleşmedi; ayrıntı çizilmez.

istemler.istem: Five very small distant human silhouettes walking in a line, carrying long wooden planks on their shoulders; no facial features at all. {yesil_perde_eki}

A gathering of about fifteen older men in simple robes and head cloths standing in an open courtyard at middle-far distance, facing the viewer, their faces in deep shadow with no visible features. No coins, purses or money anywhere. {yesil_perde_eki}

Seen from behind at close range, lower center of the frame: the head, shoulders and upper back of one man in a robe and head cloth, cut off at the waist by the bottom edge, one hand slightly raised as if speaking. His face is not visible at all. {yesil_perde_eki}
istemler.not: Ebû Vehb b. Amr; yüz kesinlikle görünmez.

istemler.istem: At dusk, a group of about twelve men in robes standing well back at a distance, hesitant, some turned half away; small in the frame, dark silhouettes against the evening light, no facial features. {yesil_perde_eki}

A single small dark silhouette of a man in a robe seen from behind, standing, holding a pickaxe raised above his head, with a little puff of stone dust. Full body inside the frame with empty margin around it. {yesil_perde_eki}
istemler.not: Velîd b. Muğîre; duvarın üstüne ayar.gorsel ile yerleştirilecek.

istemler.istem: Top-down view of an excavated pit: large, rounded, humped stones with a greenish tint set closely together in the ground, a thin layer of fine dust on them, dug-out earth around the edges, and a pickaxe lying at one edge. No people, no hands, no feet.
istemler.not: Taşların biçim ve rengi için kaynağa bakılacak (TDV KÂBE).

istemler.istem: Several very small distant groups of two or three human silhouettes, each carrying stones on their shoulders, spread across the width of the image; no facial features. {yesil_perde_eki}

Two groups of men in robes and head cloths at middle-far distance facing each other across an empty gap in the middle, tense postures, harsh midday shadows; no visible facial features. {yesil_perde_eki}

At night, a loose ring of dark human silhouettes sunk in shadow, seen at middle distance, lit only faintly from the side by warm torchlight; an empty space in the center of the ring. No facial features, no blood. {yesil_perde_eki}

A plain dark wide bowl standing on the ground, seen from a low side angle so its inside is not visible, faint warm torchlight on its rim. Nothing inside visible, no liquid, no blood. Fully inside the frame with empty margin. {yesil_perde_eki}
A simple wooden torch with a cloth-wrapped head, burning with a small flame, standing upright. Fully inside the frame with empty margin. {yesil_perde_eki}
Across an open courtyard: a plain narrow gap between two mudbrick houses with bright daylight coming through it. No arch, no gate, no frame, no decoration. No people. {yesil_perde_eki}
istemler.not: Kapının o dönemki biçimi kaynakta yok.

istemler.istem: A crowd of about eighteen men in robes at far distance, standing and listening, facing the viewer; too far for any facial features, faces in shadow. {yesil_perde_eki}

Seen from behind at close range on the left side of the frame: the shoulders and back of an old man in a robe and head cloth, standing upright, cut off by the bottom edge. His face is not visible at all. {yesil_perde_eki}
istemler.not: Ebû Ümeyye b. Muğîre; yüz görünmez.
